## Kinema 1.3

- **See what's downloaded at a glance.** A download icon now sits next to the title on Home (the carousel, Continue Watching, Next Up and every row), in the Library and in search:
  - **Filled** when a film or episode is downloaded, and for a show or a season when **every episode you haven't watched yet** is downloaded.
  - **Dotted** when only some of a show's or season's episodes are, for example when you've watched 5 of 10 and downloaded 6 to 8.
- **Season tabs** on a show's page show the same icon, and the show's **Download** button says **Downloaded** or **Partly**, with **Download the unwatched rest** one tap away.
- **Download unwatched episodes**: new next to Download all episodes (on a show's page, in the season menu and when you hold a poster), so a show is ready to watch offline from where you are.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, downloads and settings. Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later).
